info.description: One close-up product photo or video with an optional label pill, used in the details grid.

label.description: Text of the label pill on the card, for example "Durable metal nib, low-profile control button".

image.description: Close-up photo for this card. Optional if video is provided.

image_alt.description: Describes the photo for screen readers and when the image fails to load.

video.description: Video clip for this card. Optional if image is provided.
